zh.title: 達美航空載重平衡系統故障，感恩節前逾千航班延誤
zh.summary: 達美航空 11 月 22 日一度改用人工計算起飛前的載重與平衡。美國聯邦航空總署短暫暫停部分飛往亞特蘭大的航班起飛；系統恢復後，航班仍有延誤。
body: 美國感恩節旅運高峰前，達美航空 11 月 22 日（週日）用於起飛前載重與平衡計算的自動化系統發生故障。達美表示，修復期間改以人工計算，讓航班能安全放行；當天稍晚自動計算功能恢復，但航班一時未能恢復正常。美聯社報導，達美當天有逾千班航班延誤。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）應達美要求，一度暫停部分飛往哈茲菲爾德－傑克遜亞特蘭大國際機場（ATL）的達美及其區域支線航班起飛，隨後改採地面延誤計畫。FAA 表示，這次延誤與其航管系統無關。
達美表示，將協助受影響旅客改訂航班，並在有需要時提供餐食及住宿。航班取消且選擇不旅行的旅客可獲退款。

en.title: Delta Air Lines weight-and-balance outage delays more than 1,000 flights before Thanksgiving
en.summary: Delta switched to manual pre-departure weight-and-balance calculations on November 22. The FAA briefly held some Atlanta-bound flights at their departure airports, and delays continued after the airline restored the system.
body: Delta Air Lines' automated system for calculating aircraft weight and balance before departure failed on Sunday, November 22, as Thanksgiving travel picked up in the United States. Delta said it switched to manual calculations to dispatch flights safely while it fixed the system. Automation returned later that day, but service did not immediately return to normal. The Associated Press reported that more than 1,000 Delta flights were delayed on Sunday.

At Delta's request, the Federal Aviation Administration briefly held some Delta and regional affiliate flights bound for Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) at their departure airports. The FAA then replaced the ground stop with a ground delay program. The agency said the delays were unrelated to its own air traffic systems.
Delta said it was rebooking affected travelers and providing meals and hotel rooms where needed. The airline said customers whose flights were canceled could get refunds if they chose not to travel.

facts.claim: The November 22 outage of Delta’s automated weight-and-balance system left more than 1,000 of its flights delayed, the Associated Press reported.
Delta used manual calculations before restoring automation later on November 22.
The FAA issued an Atlanta ground stop at the carrier’s request, limited to Delta and its subsidiaries.
The FAA canceled the ground stop and issued an Atlanta ground delay program for Delta and its subsidiaries.
The FAA said the delays were unrelated to its air traffic systems.
Delta said it was rebooking affected customers, providing meals and hotel rooms where needed, and refunding customers who decided not to travel after their flights were canceled.
